title: I paid for protection 62 times. Won 25.8% of them. Down $8,451 (simulated). Buying puts is expensive — I knew that, but seeing the bleed per week is different.
author: QuanTradin
selftext: **This bot buys daily puts as a hedge trigger. The equity curve is a staircase down — theta eating premium week after week, with one spike that gave most of it back. Genuine question: does anyone run systematic long puts profitably, or is protection just a cost you accept?**
